about: What the workflows ktl-sidecar installs need from GitHub, and where each setting goes. `ktl gh` reads this file; repository-settings.md describes its fields. A recommended setting with no workflow applies to every repository.

ingest.title: host of knowledge from outside the repository

settings.name: knowledge-librarian
settings.why: It holds the agent's key for the refresh job on the default branch alone. A reviewer would hold up every scheduled run.

settings.name: knowledge-sync
settings.why: It holds the sync's token for the sync's jobs on the default branch alone. A reviewer would hold up every scheduled run.

settings.name: knowledge-ingest
settings.why: It holds the ingest's credentials for the ingest job on the default branch alone. A reviewer would hold up every scheduled run.

settings.name: knowledge-federation
settings.why: The build reads the members' token here, and a release build runs on the release's tag.

settings.name: github-pages
settings.why: The federation deploys the site from the release's tag as well as from the default branch.

settings.name: knowledge-curation
settings.why: Its required reviewers are the people who may attest a curation. With none it approves itself the moment it is reached.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARIAN_ENABLED

requires.text: AGENT_API_KEY_ENV, the name the agent reads its credential from
a credential: AGENT_USE_JOB_TOKEN set to true, or the AGENT_API_KEY secret in Environment knowledge-librarian
Actions may create pull requests, so that the publish job can open its own

settings.why: true runs the librarian, on its schedule and by hand. Unset, every job is skipped.

settings.name: AGENT_CLI
settings.why: The agent's command, split on spaces with no quotes. It is a secret in knowledge-librarian instead only when it must embed a credential.

settings.name: AGENT_PROMPT_FLAG
settings.why: Where the prompt goes: after -p unless set, after another flag, or as the last argument with arg.

settings.name: AGENT_API_KEY_ENV
settings.why: The name the agent reads its credential from. The wrapper refuses one that is not a credential's name, or that gh, git or the runner also read.

settings.name: AGENT_USE_JOB_TOKEN
settings.why: true hands the agent the job's own token, for Copilot CLI and a domain host's members script.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL
settings.why: true makes one more agent call on each run that changes the bundle, and puts the retrieval score in the pull request.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_ENABLED
settings.why: true attaches the bundle to each published release. A run by hand needs no switch.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_NAME
settings.why: The name the release's files carry, when it is not the repository's.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_M365_ENABLED
settings.why: true attaches a Microsoft 365 Copilot skill zip to each release beside the bundle. Leave it unset while that skill is unfinished.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_ATTEST_PRIVATE

requires.text: a private or internal repository; a public one is attested without it

requires.confirm: the owner has GitHub Enterprise Cloud, which attestations of a private repository need

settings.why: true attests the release files of a private or internal repository.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_FEDERATION_ENABLED

requires.text: Pages builds its site from GitHub Actions
no other publisher of the Pages site
KNOWLEDGE_WEBSITE_ENABLED unset, since this workflow deploys the site

settings.why: true builds the workspace on each release and deploys the site with it.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_INGEST_ENABLED

requires.text: .lokf/ingest.yaml, the manifest of what to mirror
each KNOWLEDGE_INGEST_ secret the manifest names, in Environment knowledge-ingest
Actions may create pull requests, so that the publish job can open its own

settings.why: true turns the weekly ingest on.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_CURATION_ENVIRONMENT
settings.why: Names the Environment whose reviewers may attest a curation no signature backs. Unset, the attestation job never runs.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_RUNNER
settings.why: The label of the runner every job runs on, ubuntu-latest unless set.

settings.name: AGENT_API_KEY
settings.why: The agent's key or token. The wrapper hands it to the agent alone, under the name AGENT_API_KEY_ENV gives.

settings.name: AGENT_CLI
settings.why: The agent's command as a secret, only when it must embed a credential.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_SYNC_TOKEN
settings.why: A fine-grained token for this repository alone, with Contents, Pull requests and Workflows read and write. Without it, each sync attaches its change and opens no pull request.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_FEDERATE_TOKEN
settings.why: A token that reads the members in private or internal repositories. The check job reads a repository copy, so keep one there only when the token reads the members and nothing else.

settings.name: UV_INDEX_KNOWLEDGE_USERNAME
settings.why: The user name for a private package index that .lokf/pyproject.toml names knowledge. Set it in the knowledge-sync and knowledge-librarian Environments.

settings.name: UV_INDEX_KNOWLEDGE_PASSWORD
settings.why: The password or token for a private package index that .lokf/pyproject.toml names knowledge. Set it in the knowledge-sync and knowledge-librarian Environments.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_INGEST_*
settings.why: A credential .lokf/ingest.yaml names. The workflow hands over these and no other secret.

settings.name: repository.default_branch
settings.why: The workflow's push trigger names main, so with another default branch the site rebuilds only on a release or by hand.

settings.name: actions.default_workflow_permissions
settings.why: A workflow that names no permissions gets a read-only token. Every KTL workflow names its own.

settings.name: actions.sha_pinning_required
settings.why: GitHub runs no action that is not pinned to a commit, so a moved tag cannot change what runs. Every KTL workflow pins by commit.

settings.name: security.secret_scanning
settings.why: GitHub reports a credential committed by mistake.

settings.name: security.secret_scanning_push_protection
settings.why: GitHub refuses a push that carries a credential it recognises.

settings.name: security.private_vulnerability_reporting
settings.why: A reporter can tell you of a vulnerability in private. GitHub offers it on public repositories only.

settings.name: security.vulnerability_alerts
settings.why: Dependabot says when a dependency has a known vulnerability.

settings.name: security.dependabot_security_updates
settings.why: Dependabot opens a pull request that moves a vulnerable dependency to a fixed release.

settings.name: release
settings.why: By convention, the Environment a release job runs in. With no required reviewer, a qualifying merge releases with no person's step.

settings.name: default branch
settings.why: Nobody can delete the default branch or rewrite its history, so the commit each confirmation and release names stays in it.

settings.name: release tags
settings.why: A release tag cannot be moved or deleted, so a pin or a member concept that names it names what was released. Creating a tag stays open to the release job.

settings.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
settings.why: OpenSSF Scorecard checks pinned actions, token permissions, branch rules and more each week, and publishes a score that a README badge can show. It publishes for a public repository only.

retired.name: KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARIAN_CMD
retired.why: The librarian workflow runs the reviewed wrapper, not a command a variable names. KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARIAN_ENABLED turns it on, and AGENT_CLI names the agent.

retired.name: KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARIAN_CMD
retired.why: The librarian workflow runs the reviewed wrapper, not a command a secret names. A command that must embed a credential is the AGENT_CLI secret.

retired.name: KNOWLEDGE_SKILLS_TOKEN
retired.why: Hosts install the skills from the ktl package that .lokf/pyproject.toml pins, not from a clone. A private index's credential is UV_INDEX_KNOWLEDGE_USERNAME and UV_INDEX_KNOWLEDGE_PASSWORD.
